name: Gridmet Meteorology Related Variables
description: Spatial aggregations of Gridmet meteorological variables. The spatial aggregation are performed over meteorology related variables from (raster) grid into (GIS vector) polygons.

content.Related publications: Abatzoglou, J.T., 2013. Development of gridded surface meteorological data for ecological applications and modelling. International journal of climatology, 33(1), pp.121-131.  https://doi.org/10.1002/joc.3413

content.day: Timestamp: Date of the estimated meteorological variables
content.th: Float64: Wind direction at 10m (°Degrees clockwise from North)

name: Gridmet Meteorology Related Variables
description: County seasonal spatial aggregations. Summer season spans June 1 through August 31, while winter encompasses January 1 through February 28 (or 29 in leap years) and December 1 through 31 within the same calendar year.

content.year: Integer: Year of the estimated meteorological variables
content.vpd_summer: Float64: Mean vapor pressure deficit - summer (kPa)
content.vpd_winter: Float64: Mean vapor pressure deficit - winter (kPa)
content.tmmn_summer: Float64: Minimum near-surface air temperature - summer (°K)
content.tmmn_winter: Float64: Minimum near-surface air temperature - winter (°K)
content.tmmx_summer: Float64: Maximum near-surface air temperature - summer (°K)
content.tmmx_winter: Float64: Maximum near-surface air temperature - winter (°K)
content.rmin_summer: Float64: Minimum near-surface relative humidity - summer (%)
content.rmin_winter: Float64: Minimum near-surface relative humidity - winter (%)
content.rmax_summer: Float64: Maximum near-surface relative humidity - summer (%)
content.rmax_winter: Float64: Maximum near-surface relative humidity - winter (%)
content.srad_summer: Float64: Surface downwelling solar radiation - summer (W/m^2)
content.srad_winter: Float64: Surface downwelling solar radiation - winter (W/m^2)
content.th_summer: Float64: Wind direction at 10m - summer (°Degrees clockwise from North)
content.th_winter: Float64: Wind direction at 10m - winter (°Degrees clockwise from North)
